scope: Round 3 exact-unit visual review, actual browser motion and targeted actual-pixel contrast; section rubric only, not owner acceptance or mechanical gate waiver

Source copy length, intrinsic company assets and church palette intentionally differ; no pixel similarity percentage claimed.
Whole-unit build crops exclude fixed browser/header chrome for unobstructed content review; opening and motion screenshots retain actual header.
No physical phone, exact source editor timing, all-frame contrast proof or owner Accepted status claimed.
Targeted overlay/hero contrast sampling is not a complete WCAG audit of every text node or every transitional frame.
Source Lou first-arrival is observed but per-character implementation parity is not claimed; intact-unit clarity avoids hiding essential copy.
